rationale: tv_iterative-claude-agentic: val_n=200, tv_lambda=0.001, tv_iterations=400, tv_lr=0.01, tv_decay=0.01, tv_optimizer=gd, tv_init=fbp, rationale=iter-2 CONVERGENCE probe. iter-1 (200 iters, lambda=1e-3, gd, fbp) gave hr=0.16648/ssim=0.9612 -> plain TV DOES clear the FBP baseline on breast (documented hr=0 ceiling did NOT hold at the seed config). ONE knob: tv_iterations 200->400 (2x GD steps; lambda/lr/decay/init all fixed). HYPOTHESIS: if hr climbs past 0.16648 the GD data-consistency+TV solve was not converged at 200 iters and more iters help; if it saturates, the solve is already converged and I pivot to lambda/lr. Budget: iter-1 ran ~190s at 200 iters -> ~380s at 400, <<1200s.
